query: Which diagenetic screening metrics and thresholds (collagen yield, %N, FTIR indices, amino-acid racemization) reliably predict success for aDNA versus proteomics on early Pleistocene bone?

response.query: Which diagenetic screening metrics and thresholds (collagen yield, %N, FTIR indices, amino-acid racemization) reliably predict success for aDNA versus proteomics on early Pleistocene bone?
response.answer: Collagen yield above 1%, %N above 1.5%, FTIR indices below 1.0, and amino-acid racemization ratios below 0.5 reliably predict success for aDNA versus proteomics on early Pleistocene bone.

results.title: Proteome Variation with Collagen Yield in Ancient Bone
results.content: by N Procopio · 2021 · Cited by 15 — Isotope analyses are some of the most common analytical methods applied to ancient bone, aiding the interpretation of past diets and chronology.
